topic: Data source for dwell time and impressions
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data aggregation for dwell time and impressions. Initially, it was determined that the metrics should be copied from 'connected' facilities rather than neighboring ones. To implement this, someone stated they would write two scripts: one for historical data and another for daily aggregation into a real aggregate.

Later, [p1] requested to discuss impressions specifically.
decisions: Dwell time and location metrics will be sourced from 'connected' facilities.
action_items: Someone will write two scripts (historical and daily) for data aggregation.
